title: Fertilizer attention -> CF abs return 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT fertilizer attention share 20d z-score > 1 leads CF absolute returns by 5 days (+) as attention spikes predict volatility rather than direction; long CF straddle proxy 5d [gdelt.gkg.fertilizer_share -> finance.CF.abs_return] (parent: R2-0046)
message: Supported: fertilizer attention z>1 vs CF abs return r=0.22 n=390 best lag -6d r=0.29; trade rule 45 trades hit 1.0 avg 2.2% (abs-return target inflates hit rate; caveat)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.fertilizer_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: GDELT fertilizer attention share 20d z-score > 1 leads CF absolute returns by 5 days (+) using a placebo target; if the trade rule also fires on unrelated volatility the fertilizer signal is a war common-cause artifact [gdelt.gkg.fertilizer_share -> finance.CF.range_pct] (parent: R2-0145)
